draft.subject: Getting your first project started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks again for making time for our welcome call last week. Picking up where we left off: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting that first one in place is the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time whenever you're ready to bring the team in.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you live.

Best,
Chidi
